effect_description_eng:
[Trash] [All Turns] When an effect plays an opponent's Digimon or Tamer, 1 of your [Leviamon] or Digimon with [X Antibody] in their digivolution cards may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.
＜Security A. +2＞ (This Digimon checks 2 additional security cards.)
[When Digivolving] If your opponent has as many or more total Digimon and Tamers as you, delete 1 of their Tamers. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3, 1 of their level 5 and 1 of their level 7 Digimon.
